title: Operations on an already normalized varying coefficient system
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l. Suppose a family c of commutative ring sheaves on the vertical pro-etale sites satisfies TowerCoefficients of [def-sp-compact-projection-presentation]: its underlying ring presheaf is the recorded quotient-ring system, its spatial structural maps are the constant-section maps, and its module categories are equivalent to the coefficient towers by equivalences preserving whole module presheaves and maps. Then c admits a simultaneous presentation with invertible inverse open projection and open base-change mates. This conclusion does not construct c or its normalized equivalence.

proof.text: On the vertical diagram site, scheme inverse image keeps the coefficient index fixed. The actual quotient-ring sheaves and spatial constant-section maps identify the pulled-back coefficient ring with the target ring. Inverse image of module sheaves is therefore exact. The actual module adjunction and K-injective resolutions give the spatial operations.

proof.text: Localize signed total tensor on flat-term K-flat complexes, using one tensor model per scheme. Pure scalar-extension tensors and their bidegree totalizations supply the normalized comparisons for every spatial pullback. The coefficient transitions remain part of the vertical site, rather than separate derived evaluations.

proof.text: The iterated fibre-product comparison gives the section-normalized direct-image square. Construct exact open extension on the same vertical site; its unit is invertible. Apply the normalized open theorem and adjunction uniqueness to identify the two open mates with its invertible comparisons.
